name: Jovvie Point of Sale POS for WooCommerce
author: bizswoop

sections.description:
Jovvie is the point of sale built for WooCommerce. Install the plugin, create a free account, and start selling in-person in minutes. Products, inventory and customers sync automatically between your online store and POS so you never have to manage two systems.

Official Stripe Partner – Accept credit, debit, Apple Pay and Google Pay using Stripe Terminal hardware including the S700 series, WisePad 3, M2 Reader and Tap to Pay for iOS and Android.

11 payment gateways, 100+ currencies – Use any gateway already configured in WooCommerce with support for station-level multi-currency for international operations.

Works on everything – Run Jovvie on iPads, Android tablets, phones, laptops or desktops through any modern browser or native apps. No proprietary hardware required.

Real-time inventory – Stock levels update instantly across online and in-person channels so you never oversell.

36 languages – Serve customers worldwide with built-in multilingual support.

Used by retail shops, restaurants, pop-ups, events and multi-location businesses in 30+ countries.

5 Minute Easy Setup Video

In just a few clicks, a fully functional point of sale system will be seamlessly integrated into your WooCommerce store and ready to accept orders.

Follow our Quick Start Guide for a step-by-step walkthrough.

Perfect For

  • Retail stores – Full inventory, barcode scanning, customer profiles and receipt printing
  • Restaurants and cafes – Order management, tipping, kitchen printing and quick checkout
  • Pop-ups and events – Portable setup on any phone or tablet with Stripe Terminal readers or Tap to Pay
  • Multi-location businesses – Multiple POS stations with centralized WooCommerce reporting

Features

Payments

  • Stripe Terminal – Tap, swipe and scan with official Stripe hardware (S700 series, WisePad 3, M2 Reader). Jovvie is an official Stripe Partner.
  • Tap to Pay – Tap to Pay with iOS or Android devices
  • Flexible gateways – Use any payment gateway already configured on your WooCommerce store
  • Split payments – Accept multiple payment methods on a single order
  • Tips – Configurable tip options at checkout

Products and Inventory

  • Real-time sync – Products, pricing, categories and stock levels stay in sync automatically
  • Barcode scanning – Scan with USB, Bluetooth or camera-based scanners with GTIN, UPC, EAN and ISBN support
  • Variable products – Full support for product variations, add-ons and custom products
  • Product tabs – Organize your catalog with custom tab layouts and category filtering

Customers and Team

  • Customer management – Search, create and edit customer profiles at the register
  • Employee logins – Individual cashier and manager accounts with role-based permissions
  • Passcode switching – Fast user switching between team members on shared devices

Operations

  • Receipt and order printing – Connect receipt printers and kitchen printers via BizPrint
  • Customer notifications – Send text, email and WhatsApp alerts via FlowNotify
  • Reporting – POS analytics integrated into your WooCommerce dashboard with user, station and gateway breakdowns
  • Kiosk mode – Lock the POS to a single station for self-service or dedicated terminals
  • Coupons – Apply WooCommerce coupons directly from the POS
  • Tax handling – Inclusive and exclusive tax support with multiple tax classes
  • Cash management – Cash drawer tracking with open/close workflows
  • Refunds – Process full or partial refunds with predefined reason codes
  • Multi-currency – Station-level currency support for international operations
  • Light and dark mode – Customizable theme colors to match your brand

Integrations

  • WooCommerce Subscriptions
  • WooCommerce Gift Cards
  • WooCommerce Points and Rewards

More Information

sections.faq:
How do I get started?

Install the plugin, create a free BizSwoop account, and follow the quick start guide. You can be up and running in under 5 minutes.

Is Jovvie free?

Jovvie includes free orders to get started so you can try everything before committing. Plans for growing businesses are available at jovvie.com/pricing.

What hardware do I need?

Jovvie runs in any modern browser on any device. For card payments, connect a Stripe Terminal reader (S700 series, WisePad 3 or M2) or Tap to Pay for iOS and Android. No proprietary POS hardware required.

Can I use my existing WooCommerce payment gateways?

Yes. In addition to Stripe Terminal, Jovvie supports any payment gateway already configured in your WooCommerce store.

Do you provide support?

Yes. We actively develop and support both the plugin and the Jovvie cloud app. Submit a support request, report bugs or request features at jovvie.com/support.

Can I request features and new functionality?

Yes, we encourage you to submit features and functionality request that would improve the POS. Please use the Jovvie Support. Label the issue as a Feature Request.
